items.name: Sprite Bottle
items.rules: When you mark your last Hit Point, this bottle shatters to release the Sprite inside. The Sprite clears all your Hit Points before fading from the Mortal Realm.

items.name: Displacement Token
items.rules: You can swallow this token to conjure two illusions of yourself that you can control. Each illusion lasts until it takes damage or until your next rest.

items.name: Stonemason’s Fortune
items.rules: When you throw this gray brick on the ground, it immediately grows into a 6-foot-tall, 10-foot-wide, and 2-foot- deep wall of solid stone.

items.name: Homet’s Secret Potion
items.rules: After drinking this potion, the next successful attack you make critically succeeds.

items.name: Midas Flask
items.rules: You can pour this small flask of alchemical liquid over a mundane item to instantly transmute it into a handful of gold.

items.name: Staff of Reversal
items.rules: You can break this staff against the ground to reverse one magical transformation or effect within Far range.

items.name: Berserker’s Brew
items.rules: When you drink this dram of liquid, you gain a bonus to your Strength and a penalty to your Finesse and Knowledge equal to your Instinct (minimum 1). This effect lasts until you make a death move or until your next rest.

items.name: Hopehold Flare
items.rules: When you use this flare, allies within Close range roll a d6 when they spend a Hope. On a result of 6, they gain the effect of that Hope without spending it. The flare lasts until the end of the scene.

items.name: Circle of the Void
items.rules: Mark a Stress to create a void that extends up to Far range. No magic can be cast inside the void, and creatures within the void are immune to magic damage.

items.name: Cacophonous Concoction
items.rules: When you drink this potion, anything you say or do in the next hour becomes impossible for a witness to recount. Any attempts they make to communicate what they saw, heard, or otherwise sensed comes out garbled or nonsensical.

items.name: Nightmare Mead
items.rules: You can drink this potion to discover the deepest fear of the next person you make eye contact with. When you do, the GM gains a Fear.

items.name: Stake of Abjuration
items.rules: You can hammer this stake into the ground and make a proclamation. Until your next rest, a creature within Far range of the stake who transgresses that proclamation must mark a Stress. The stake lasts until your next rest, then it shatters.

items.name: Psychopomp’s Shroud
items.rules: You can place this shroud over the corpse of a recently deceased creature. The creature’s spirit enters the shroud and becomes your spectral assistant until the next sunrise, when they pass through the veil of death and take the shroud with them.

items.name: Phial of Deep Ink
items.rules: You can drink this bottle of ink to transform into a cephalopod of roughly your size for the next hour. You gain rubbery skin, soft bones, the ability to breathe underwater, and new limbs until you have eight total.

items.name: Mesmer’s Tonic
items.rules: When you drink this tonic, the only thing you can hear until your next rest are the surface thoughts of creatures within Very Close range.

items.name: Formoid Serum
items.rules: You can drink this potion to become a swarm of 16 million ants until the end of the scene. You keep and have access to all equipment, loot, and features.

items.name: Steelskin Salve
items.rules: You can apply this salve to your skin to gain a bonus to your damage thresholds equal to your tier until the end of the scene.

items.name: Block House
items.rules: Toss this wooden block to conjur a phatasmal doorway where it lands. Within occupants can close and seal the door, erasing it from the world. At the end of 1 day everything brought in appears at the threshold and the door vanishes forever.

items.name: Snakeskin Spirit
items.rules: You can drink this potion to slough off your outer layer of skin and heal a scar.

items.name: Bonding Honey
items.rules: This honey can be used to glue two objects together permanently.

items.name: Magic-User’s Malison
items.rules: When you release this spellcaster’s trapped soul, you can cast one spell from a card in your vault as if it were in your loadout. This doesn’t work for permanently vaulted cards.

items.name: Shrinking Potion
items.rules: You can drink this potion to halve your size until you choose to drop this form or your next rest. While in this form, you have a +2 bonus to Agility and a −1 penalty to your Proficiency.

items.name: Quintessential Severant
items.rules: You can use this magic blade to cut one magical or metaphysical bond, such as an enchantment, contract, magical tether, or divine oath. When you do, the blade shatters.

items.name: Growing Potion
items.rules: You can drink this potion to double your size until you choose to drop this form or your next rest. While in this form, you have a +2 bonus to Strength and a +1 bonus to your Proficiency.

items.name: Mask of the Echoed Self
items.rules: You can wear this mask during your next level up to swap the values of any of your traits. When you do, the mask becomes your permanent face.

items.name: Knowledge Stone
items.rules: If you die while holding this stone, an ally can take a card from your loadout to place in their loadout or vault. After they take this knowledge, the stone crumbles.

items.name: Necroprancer’s Bell
items.rules: You can break this rusted, clapperless bell against the ground to summon a skeletal steed that climbs out of the earth and serves you until the next sunrise.

items.name: Drakemantle
items.rules: You can use this enchanted ancient dragon hide to gain draconic characteristics until the end of the scene, when the hide falls aways in tatters. Until then, you can fly and gain a +5 bonus to your damage thresholds and a +1 bonus to your Proficiency.

items.name: Lionheart Tonic
items.rules: You can drink this tonic to gain a +1 bonus to your Proficiency until you roll with Fear.

items.name: Tears of the Undying Hero
items.rules: When you drink this potion, death can’t touch you until your next long rest. When you would mark your last Hit Point, instead of making a death move, you make one final action roll before falling into a dreamless slumber until an ally chooses the Tend to Wounds downtime move to clear your Hit Points.

items.name: Steward Aegis Beacon
items.rules: Light to fill an area within Close range with a protective field. A creature outside it can't enter if it has ill intent toward a creature inside. Lasts an hour.

items.name: Castrovel Chameleon Spray
items.rules: Spray on yourself to blend perfectly into natural environments until your next rest.

items.name: Voxsplice Lozenge
items.rules: Dissolve to perfectly mimic any voice you've heard until the end of the scene.

items.name: Fall-Damp Ampoule
items.rules: Drink to ignore falling damage for 10 minutes.

items.name: Null-G Dust
items.rules: Anything this dust covers becomes weightless for an hour. One packet covers a small crate's contents.

items.name: Low-Light Ocular Drops
items.rules: Apply to see in total darkness until your next rest.

items.name: Pharasmin Echo Powder
items.rules: Sprinkle on a recently deceased corpse to project a holographic replay of their final minute of life.

items.name: Pharasmin Grave Salt
items.rules: Spread in a line along windowsills or thresholds. Undead creatures can't cross it until the line is broken.

items.name: Glowspore Pod
items.rules: Break apart to make it glow bright blue until your next long rest.

items.name: Morphic Gel
items.rules: Spend a Hope and apply to alter your face enough to be unrecognizable until your next rest.

items.name: Compact Habitat Module
items.rules: Unfold into a shelter that safely houses six people. It collapses at the end of your next long rest.

items.name: Leap Capsule
items.rules: Take to leap up to Far range once without rolling.

items.name: Gecko Grip Pads
items.rules: Wear to walk on walls until your next rest.

items.name: Nanite Armor Stitcher
items.rules: Spend any number of Hope to clear that many Armor Slots.

items.name: Oxy-Gill Patch
items.rules: Apply to your neck to breathe underwater for minutes equal to your level.

items.name: Listening Mote
items.rules: Plant on a surface. It records everything it hears for up to one week. When triggered, it plays the recording back in real time, then burns out.

items.name: Replica Film
items.rules: Touch to another document to perfectly copy its contents. Afterward it becomes blank film.

items.name: Autosuture Spool
items.rules: Use to clear either a Hit Point or 2 Armor Slots.

items.name: Thermoshield Gel
items.rules: Apply to your skin to become immune to heat until your next rest.

items.name: Dayglow Orb
items.rules: Shatter to make the area within Very Far range appear sunlit for 24 hours.

items.name: Drift-Skip Serum
items.rules: Drink to vanish and reappear at a point you can see within Very Far range.

items.name: Nightglow Orb
items.rules: Shatter to make the area within Very Far range appear moonlit for 24 hours.

items.name: Spellcache Drive
items.rules: Use to take a spell or grimoire from your vault, use it once, and return it to your vault.

items.name: Gravchute Module
items.rules: Use to control your falling speed for minutes equal to your level.

items.name: Ghost-Signature Spray
items.rules: Use to prevent anyone from tracking you by any means until your next rest.

items.name: Disposable Jetpack
items.rules: Use to fly for minutes equal to your level.

items.name: Cloak Injector
items.rules: You are Hidden until you deal damage to another creature or until your next rest.

items.name: Castrovel Bridgevine Seed
items.rules: Thick vines grow from your location to a point of your choice within Far range, letting you climb up or across. They dissipate on your next short rest.

items.name: Emergency Deflector
items.rules: When you take damage, spend a Hope to negate it. The deflector then burns out.

items.name: Hoverstep Pods
items.rules: Wear to gain a bonus to your Evasion equal to your tier until your next rest.

items.name: Tracer Dust
items.rules: This multicolored powder sticks to everything and prevents creatures covered in it from becoming Hidden.

items.name: Flash-Freeze Charge
items.rules: Use to instantly freeze an area of water up to Close range.

items.name: Aether Coating
items.rules: Apply to a weapon that deals physical damage to change its damage type to magic until your next rest.

items.name: Eoxian Toxin Coating
items.rules: Apply to a weapon that deals physical damage to add a d6 to your next damage roll with it.

items.name: Flux Grenade
items.rules: Make a Finesse Roll to throw at a group of adversaries within Far range. Targets you succeed against take 1d20 magic damage.

items.name: Refined Eoxian Toxin
items.rules: Apply to a weapon that deals physical damage to add a d8 to your next damage roll with it.

items.name: Thermite Gel
items.rules: Coat your weapon. The next successful attack with it deals an extra 1d8 magic damage and temporarily Ignites the target. While Ignited, the target takes 1d4 magic damage when they take the spotlight.

items.name: Obscurant Canister
items.rules: When an adversary attacks you, use this and roll a number of d6s equal to your Agility. Add the highest result to your Evasion against the attack.

items.name: Calm-Mist Canister
items.rules: Break to fill the area within Close range with mist. A creature who enters the mist clears a Stress and becomes Hidden.

items.name: Snarevine Pod
items.rules: Throw at a point you can see. It bursts into binding vines that temporarily Restrain all creatures within Close range of that point.

items.name: Graviton Grenade
items.rules: Throw at a point within Far range. It implodes and pulls all creatures and objects within Close range of that point into Melee range with it.

items.name: Improved Flux Grenade
items.rules: Make a Finesse Roll to throw at a group of adversaries within Far range. Targets you succeed against take 2d20 magic damage.

items.name: Panic Aerosol
items.rules: Spray in an adversary's face to prevent them from clearing Stress until your next long rest.

items.name: Corrodent Gel
items.rules: Coat your weapon. The next successful attack with it deals an extra 1d8 magic damage and temporarily Corrodes the target. While Corroded, the target gains a −2 penalty to their damage thresholds.

items.name: Akitonian Redthorn Resin
items.rules: Apply to a weapon that deals physical damage to add a d12 to your next damage roll with it.

items.name: Mystic Resonance Dust
items.rules: Apply to a weapon that deals magic damage to add a d12 to your next damage roll with it.

items.name: Incendiary Grenade
items.rules: Choose a point within Far range. All targets within Close range of it must succeed on a Reaction Roll (16) or take 3d6 magic damage and become temporarily Ablaze. While Ablaze, a creature rolls a d4 whenever they make an action roll: on a 1 they mark a Hit Point, on a 4 they clear Ablaze.

items.name: Acid Breach Paste
items.rules: This paste eats through walls and other surfaces.

items.name: Cryo Grenade
items.rules: Choose a point within Far range. All targets within Close range of it must succeed on a Reaction Roll (16) or take 3d6 magic damage and become temporarily Restrained by ice.

items.name: Arc Grenade
items.rules: Choose a point within Far range. All targets within Close range of it must succeed on a Reaction Roll (16) or take 3d6 magic damage and mark 1d4 Stress as electricity arcs through the area.

items.name: Major Flux Grenade
items.rules: Make a Finesse Roll to throw at a group of adversaries within Far range. Targets you succeed against take 4d20 magic damage.

items.name: Overclock Draught
items.rules: Drink to gain a +1 bonus to your Proficiency for your next successful attack roll.

items.name: Necrotoxin Vial
items.rules: A creature who consumes this takes 8d10 direct magic damage.

items.name: Sonic Howler Canister
items.rules: Open to release a deafening sonic blast for a number of minutes equal to your Instinct. Creatures within Far range unprepared for it take 6d8 magic damage.

items.name: Pyrobreath Draught
items.rules: Drink to unleash a fiery breath attack. Make an Instinct Roll against all adversaries in front of you within Close range. Targets you succeed against take d20 physical damage using your Proficiency.

items.name: Gilded Seeker Drone
items.rules: Name a target you can see. This drone launches into them. They mark 1d10 HP and 1d10 Stress.

items.name: Flashbang
items.rules: Activate to create a flash of bright light. All targets within Close range become Vulnerable until they mark HP.

items.name: Credit Bomb
items.rules: Place any number of handfuls of gold into this slotted casing. Throw it at a point within Far range: it explodes, dealing 1d20 magic damage per handful spent to all creatures within Close range of that point. The gold is destroyed.

items.name: Kill-Switch Draught
items.rules: After you drink this, you instantly kill your target when you critically succeed on an attack. If you don't critically succeed on an attack before your next long rest, you die.

items.name: Orbital Bombardment Beacon
items.rules: Use to call down an orbital barrage that deals 8d20 physical damage to all targets within Very Far range.

items.name: Stride Stim
items.rules: You gain a +1 bonus to your next Agility Roll.

items.name: Bolster Stim
items.rules: You gain a +1 bonus to your next Strength Roll.

items.name: Control Stim
items.rules: You gain a +1 bonus to your next Finesse Roll.

items.name: Attune Stim
items.rules: You gain a +1 bonus to your next Instinct Roll.

items.name: Charm Stim
items.rules: You gain a +1 bonus to your next Presence Roll.

items.name: Enlighten Stim
items.rules: You gain a +1 bonus to your next Knowledge Roll.

items.name: Antitox Capsule
items.rules: Swallow to become immune to poisons until your next long rest.

items.name: Minor Health Stim
items.rules: Clear 1d4 HP.

items.name: Minor Stamina Stim
items.rules: Clear 1d4 Stress.

items.name: Morale Tabs
items.rules: Take this paired dose to immediately gain 2 Hope.

items.name: Calm Inhaler
items.rules: When you choose the Clear Stress downtime move during a short rest, use this non-intoxicating inhaler to clear an additional Stress. Other PCs who chose Clear Stress gain this benefit too.

items.name: Respite Stim
items.rules: Drink to choose one additional downtime move.

items.name: Nanite Regen Shake
items.rules: After drinking, the next time you clear 1 or more Hit Points, you clear an additional Hit Point.

items.name: Adrenal Snap
items.rules: Mark a Stress and clear a HP.

items.name: Health Stim
items.rules: Clear 1d4+1 HP.

items.name: Stamina Stim
items.rules: Clear 1d4+1 Stress.

items.name: Major Stride Stim
items.rules: You gain a +1 bonus to your Agility until your next rest.

items.name: Major Bolster Stim
items.rules: You gain a +1 bonus to your Strength until your next rest.

items.name: Major Control Stim
items.rules: You gain a +1 bonus to your Finesse until your next rest.

items.name: Major Attune Stim
items.rules: You gain a +1 bonus to your Instinct until your next rest.

items.name: Major Charm Stim
items.rules: You gain a +1 bonus to your Presence until your next rest.

items.name: Major Enlighten Stim
items.rules: You gain a +1 bonus to your Knowledge until your next rest.

items.name: Mnemonic Stim
items.rules: Drink to Utilize an Experience without spending a Hope.

items.name: Recharge Stim
items.rules: Drink to refresh your features as if you had taken a long rest.

items.name: Vigilance Stim
items.rules: Drink to gain a +1 bonus to your Evasion until you mark a Hit Point.

items.name: Sunbloom Serum
items.rules: Inject and roll a d6. On 5–6, clear 2 HP. On 2–4, clear 3 Stress. On 1, brush death and return changed, gaining one scar.

items.name: Major Health Stim
items.rules: Clear 1d4+2 HP.

items.name: Major Stamina Stim
items.rules: Clear 1d4+2 Stress.

items.name: Panacea Injector
items.rules: Inject to clear all Hit Points and Stress.

items.name: Absalom Feast Pack
items.rules: Eat this meal to clear all HP and Stress and gain 1d4 Hope.
